extra_findings.detail: Strategy A is 2000 assemblies x 3 estimators, Strategy B is 200 x 1 estimator over a subset of the same final draw. Only the per-estimator comparison is admissible, and even that is unpaired. The paired A/B bootstrap on the 200 shared assemblies is NOT_RUN and the reason is budget, not impossibility.
the report claimed 5 calibration frames per unit; g2.py:1046 takes 9 in the non-quick path. The report text was wrong, the code was right, and the cost of strategy B was understated by 80%.

the L1 image-height formula printed in 03_SCIENTIFIC_AUDIT.md section 4 carries an extra 1/Z. At Z=200 mm it yields 648.43 px against a traced 879.95 px, an error of -231.51 px that is 96.5% of the very offset the formula is meant to explain. The error class is an algebraic power of Z, not a sign.

supporting_measurement.interpretation: c is the object-side principal-plane offset, NOT the 8 mm focal length. A thin-lens reading would be wrong twice over. Falsifiable prediction: if the sentence's 'image distance / Z' mechanism were right, c would land near 8 mm; it lands at -1.45 mm.

extra_findings.detail: cmd_report previously dispatched schema 2.0 and fell through to schema 1.0 for everything else, so a G2 run failed with ConfigError. A three-way resolver _resolve_report_config now dispatches 1.0/2.0/3.0 from the config snapshot, and cmd_report calls render_g2_report for kind == G2.

extra_findings.detail: robust buys a 1.19 mm lower RMSE for a 3.14 pp higher failure rate. Any ranking that collapses this to a single score is rejected; the UI shows all three metrics side by side and does not auto-select a winner.

open_issues.title: HC3 as registered (>= 0.999) is structurally unreachable for this optical model
open_issues.detail: width of the PSF window is driven by the geometric footprint (3-9 um) while the Airy radius is ~1.4 px; the truncation loss is therefore baked into the window rule. The observed ceiling is 0.972-0.991.
open_issues.proposed_resolution: explicit post-hoc amendment documents/ G2_CONSTRAINTS_AMENDMENT.md restating HC3 at 0.950 with the derivation, marked as an amendment and never as the original text

verdict_rationale: Two independent lines are recorded because they are independent. The engineering history did run to PASS and its numbers are internally consistent to 1e-9 over 126000 rows - that is as_run_numerical_verification PASS. The registered procedure was not followed in at least four material ways - that is original_prereg_compliance FAIL. Collapsing these into a single G2_ALL_PASS token would assert something neither line supports. The scientific claim is therefore QUALIFIED_ONLY: the paired RMSE ordering survives, but every published sentence must carry the four deviation tokens and the failure-rate tradeoff.
